scripts.postbuild: D="${NEXT_DIST_DIR:-.next}"; B=$(cat "$D/BUILD_ID" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$B" ]; then echo "postbuild: $D/BUILD_ID RONG hoac THIEU — dau vet ban dung se vo nghia" >&2; exit 1; fi; { (git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo KHONG-CO-GIT); echo "# THU-MUC-DUNG: $D"; echo "# BUILD_ID: $B"; (git status --porcelain -- src du-lieu 2>/dev/null || true) | sed "s/^/# CAY-BAN /"; } > "$D/COMMIT"
